reviewer.independence_basis: Separate Astra reviewer with no author conversation. Independently inspected the fixed source, candidate, policy, artifact hashes and mock-only boundary; rebuilt from git archive. No host operation was performed.

code_candidate_evidence: The binary, installer, unit, CSS and policy SHA-256 values match the candidate; a clean git archive rebuild of the source commit produced the same Linux amd64 binary hash.
The unit fixes ExecStart to 127.0.0.1:8787 and mock-worker; the program rejects a non-loopback bind and a mock-plus-isolated worker combination.
The mock runner writes local simulated results only; it performs no model invocation, repository mutation or publication. Daily reports are local outbox records.
Source changes since e3b022f add App/Platform acceptance, correction, retesting and display. Mock reconciliation remains ledger-only; added worktree activity is isolated-worker-only.
The installer rejects occupied dedicated identities, paths, unit/drop-ins, registered service and port 8787; locks installation and verifies hashes in protected staging and after installation.

The installer checks effective systemd fragment, drop-ins, identity, command and environment before enable/start. It creates a 0600 token file under dedicated state and does not expose the token in argv or logs.
The installer has no k3s, libvirt, Cloudflare, DNS, proxy, tunnel, firewall or existing-data mutation; failure and signal cleanup disable/stop only the armed service while preserving state.
The independent source checkout passed go test ./... for all 13 packages; installer bash -n passed.
